headline: EUROPE 🍆 GETS SABOTAGED 🔥 by RUSSIA 🇷🇺 in SPIRALLING 🔥 Hybrid 🍑 Campaign
text:
GERMANY 🇩🇪 just DROPPED 💣 the BOMB 🧨 that those DRONES 🚁 stuffed with EXPLOSIVES 💥 at LEIPZIG 🛫 airport were part of a full blown RUSSIAN 🇷🇺 hybrid 🍆 operation edging 👐 Europe HARD 🥴 while summer ☀️ temps smashed records 📈 and politicians 👔 dipped into holiday 🏖️ mode!! RUSSIA 🐻 stayed LASER 🔦 focused on its UKRAINE 🇺🇦 war hammering 💥 civilians harder than ever last month while simultaneously launching this fresh SABOTAGE 🌋 spree targeting MILITARY 🪖 and DEFENCE 🛡️ sites across the continent like some thirsty 🥵 escalation kink!! Interior minister straight up declared RUSSIA 🇷🇺 IS RESPONSIBLE 🧾 after a full MONTH 📅 delay but PUTIN 🧔 demands PROOF 📜 as always calling the whole thing ABSURD 🤡 while his officials stay in full gaslight 🕯️ mode!!

AUGUST 🔥 brought a SUS 🔥 series of FIRES 🔥 at defence facilities stretching from ITALY 🇮🇹 all the way to ESTONIA 🇪🇪 some countries already pointing the finger ☝️ at RUSSIA 🇷🇺 while others still investigate and a few might get ruled accidental 🔥 exactly how these sneaky 🍑 attacks are built to look!! POLAND 🇵🇱 interior minister MARCIN 🍑 is crystal clear that there are MANY MANY 📢 signals RUSSIA 🇷🇺 is changing strategy and cranking up its TERRORIST 🧨 and SABOTAGE 🌋 activities warning everyone to stay on their GUARD 🛡️!! The pattern started 4 AUGUST 📆 with the FIRST DRONE 🚁 discovery at LEIPZIG 🛫 used by UKRAINE 🇺🇦 to ship military goods then BULGARIA 🇧🇬 on 10 AUGUST had that MAJOR 🔥 blaze at EMCO warehouse where the company said human error is EXCLUDED 🚫 after recalling past blasts linked to RUSSIA 🇷🇺!!

ITALY 🇮🇹 caught STRAY 🔥 on 13 AUGUST when KNDS ammo plant outside ROME 🏛️ went BOOM 💥 with prosecutors sniffing around for outside interference while staying publicly vague about unknown persons and negligent disaster!! ESTONIA 🇪🇪 on 15 AUGUST watched its MILREM robotics factory that supplies DRONES 🛸 to UKRAINE 🇺🇦 burn down with two suspects already arrested and the prime minister saying they are taking RUSSIAN 🇷🇺 sabotage possibility VERY seriously!! SLOVAKIA 🇸🇰 on 25 AUGUST announced they stopped an ARSON 🔥 attempt on a UKRAINIAN 🇺🇦 owned drone maker seizing literal barrels of incendiary mix and arresting three dudes following ORDERS 📋 with the firm straight blaming RUSSIA 🇷🇺 even though it's supposedly their close ally!!

POLAND 🇵🇱 on 30 AUGUST reported two more FIRES 🔥 one at a helicopter parts company in LUBLIN where prime minister Donald Tusk said arson cannot be ruled out and another at WB Group drone producer caught on CCTV with a masked man YEETING 🔥 incendiary devices calling it continuation of RUSSIA'S 🇷🇺 escalatory activities!! The spice 🌶️ kept rolling into SEPTEMBER with two BULGARIANS arrested in MUNICH for chucking incendiary stuff from a car at defence firm Rhode & Schwartz while separately they're hunting some climate extremist who hit power substations!! EXPERTS 🧠 like Daniela Richterova from King's College note the INTENSITY on military sites lately is UNUSUAL tying the spike to UKRAINE striking deep inside RUSSIA so Moscow is under pressure and has to do SOMETHING 🫡 with this coercive signalling to make supporters stop backing KYIV!!

Other theorists say RUSSIA 🇷🇺 is really probing NATO 🛡️ boundaries testing what works and what's vulnerable collecting data for the next phase of aggression while the IISS tracks how this mirrors the 2024 parcel bomb plot with liquid explosives sent to UK and POLAND one nearly blowing up on a DHL plane!! German police reports list over 165 suspected sabotage cases this year alone with hints the LEIPZIG drone crew were actual RUSSIANS who flew in special for the job which is rare because most are gig economy saboteurs recruited online from former Soviet states chasing cash not ideology!! Handlers stay safe in RUSSIA coordinating like puppet masters while the proxies are basically kamikaze drones cheap disposable and sometimes sloppy like that one dude who couldn't even find the pickup point and aborted the whole mission!! This is straight out the COLD WAR playbook with small deniable attacks meant to escalate from grey zone into something way HOTTER 🔥 and the past weeks are shrinking that zone fast raising the risk of whatever comes NEXT 🌋!!
